title: Make untested-source reminder match named-root completion disposition
outcome: Make untested-source reminder match named-root completion disposition
acceptance: A regression covers both dispositions without changing completion's existing authority or resolution rules

For an ordinary in-root stock source change with no matching recognized test, the completion reminder says that done will record it as untested, matching evaluation_obligations and actual completion; it does not imply that every named root blocks
For foreign or unknown-root source changes that do block completion, the reminder names the credited check or authorized waiver and does not promise an automatic untested resolution

completion.summary: The stock untested-source reminder now says what done will do with each open obligation, from the classification completion already computes. An in-root change is recorded as untested. A change before the root was named is displaced, with no action. An unlocated change needs the credited check or a waiver, or a named root first once none is bound. A foreign change under a bound root needs only an authorized human waiver. Refusing cases say done refuses until then, and an unclassified page promises neither. Under a self-asserted policy only the bounded page's open obligations are classified. The evaluated-only disclosures and completion's authority and resolution are unchanged. Five named-root regressions compare the reminder with actual done. Round 3 on freeze 58979b86…f7d1 was clean from Codex and Claude, and gate test-aa5906d6 passed 9/9. Readiness reported all three live stores ready. Commit 34e722e is pushed, and build 9d65e2c1544a is installed with the previous build backed up.
